assumptions.position_sizing: min(0.25% equity risk budget, equal notional budget, combined-risk headroom); 0.10% per-share slippage allowance included in sizing
assumptions.stop_fill: stop price, or worse candle open if gapped through; stop has priority when stop and target are both touched in one candle
assumptions.target_fill: target price when touched; no extra target slippage
assumptions.eod_fill: close of first bar ending at or after 14:55 IST
assumptions.daily_loss_action: block new entries for the rest of the session; manage open positions to their configured exits
assumptions.partial_exit: 50% of whole shares at 1R (minimum one share when quantity >= 2), then move remaining stop to entry and target the remaining 2R level
assumptions.candidate_selection: for a simultaneous scanner signal, directional relative strength descending, then relative volume descending, then symbol name
assumptions.fees: Zerodha NSE equity intraday estimates, charged for entry and each exit order

recommendation: No variant was profitable after estimated charges on the holdout. Keep the configured 2R target, 0.25% risk, and scanner setting unchanged; partial-at-1R lost the least but is still unprofitable.
